name: veyrath
description: Veyrath — multiplayer-first co-op action game (Milestone 1 network foundation)

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:desktop
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npm run package -w @veyrath/desktop && node scripts/copy-server-to-release.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/sim && tsc -p packages/protocol && tsc -p services/game-server && tsc -p packages/client && tsc -p apps/desktop && tsc -p tests
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test
